formal_sketch.consequent: For each k from 0 to NumGatesPerDirection-1, a prim_blanker instance for H->D path has .in_i connected to tl_h2d_int[k], .en_i connected to lc_tx_test_false_strict(err_en_buf[k]), and .out_o driven to tl_h2d_int[k+1]

formal_sketch.consequent: For each k from 0 to NumGatesPerDirection-1, a prim_blanker instance for D->H path has .in_i connected to tl_d2h_int[k+1], .en_i connected to lc_tx_test_false_strict(err_en_buf[k]), and .out_o driven to tl_d2h_int[k]

assumptions.claim: The external context provides array sizes such that tl_h2d_int and tl_d2h_int each have at least NumGatesPerDirection+1 elements, and err_en_buf has at least NumGatesPerDirection elements.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-bounds indexing leads to synthesis errors or incorrect bus routing.

formal_sketch.consequent: The external context provides array sizes such that tl_h2d_int and tl_d2h_int each have at least NumGatesPerDirection+1 elements, and err_en_buf has at least NumGatesPerDirection elements

assumptions.claim: The prim_blanker module correctly implements blanking: when en_i is false it drives all-zero on out_o; when en_i is true it passes in_i to out_o.
assumptions.risk: If prim_blanker is faulty, sensitive TL-UL transactions may not be zeroized during life cycle error, leaking secret data.

assumptions.claim: The function lc_tx_test_false_strict correctly decodes err_en_buf[k] into a static enable signal that is high only when the life cycle state permits transactions.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect decode may cause transactions to be blocked when they should pass, or allowed when they should be blanked, leading to functional failures or security breaches.

formal_sketch.consequent: The function lc_tx_test_false_strict correctly decodes err_en_buf[k] into a static enable signal that is high only when the life cycle state permits transactions

formal_sketch.consequent: The security property that TL-UL transactions are zeroized when the life cycle is in an error state depends entirely on the correctness of the prim_blanker implementation

uncertain_points.claim: The enable generation logic inside lc_tx_test_false_strict must correctly map the life cycle state from err_en_buf to a per-cycle enable; any misinterpretation could defeat the gating.
uncertain_points.risk: An incorrect enable could leave the bus unblanked during security-critical error states, or blank it during normal operation.

formal_sketch.consequent: The enable generation logic inside lc_tx_test_false_strict must correctly map the life cycle state from err_en_buf to a per-cycle enable; any misinterpretation could defeat the gating
